statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (b : ℤ → ℝ), (∀ n, n < 0 ∨ (N:ℤ) < n → b n = 0) → let S := Finset.Icc (-2:ℤ) (N:ℤ); S.sum (fun n => (b n+b (n+2))^2) - S.sum (fun n => (b n-b (n+2))^2) = 4*S.sum (fun n => b n*b (n+2))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定平移的 Θ 提升 · TP-0044 · 在补零序列上极化平移二次型
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta lift for a prescribed shift · TP-0044 · Polarize the shift on a zero-extended sequence

brief.zh: 两个边界都用整数上的补零，逐项极化。
brief.en: Extend by zero at both boundaries on the integers and polarize term by term.
